{{Quote|Two hours ago my people intercepted a signal emanating from the secret research facility above Ipsus.|Nirama|<ref name="OA" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] a '''research station''' operated in secret in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of [[S-Ipsus]], a [[City/Legends|sub-city]] of the floating city [[Ipsus]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]]. The station was established<ref name="OA" /> in around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]<ref name="date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the Living Force adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the events depicted in ''[[Metatheran Caution: Open Aarms|Open Aarms]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> to facilitate the study of a [[Anti-Caarite virus|virus]] [[Death/Legends|fatal]] to the [[Caarite]] [[Species/Legends|species]] developed by the [[Believers]] [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]], in an attempt to better understand the contagion. The [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nirama]] learned of the research station and unofficially monitored the work conducted at the facility. After a [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]] containing a sample of the anti-Caarite virus was recovered by a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] from the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Tilnes]], the explosive device was taken to the S-Ipsus research station for further study. There, a [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking beacon]] contained within the device activated and sent a signal to a concealed [[S-Ipsus Believers laboratory|Believer laboratory]] on S-Ipsus informing the cultists that the device had not been detonated.<ref name="OA" />
